# 1StopCoverage.ca

> 1StopCoverage.ca is a RIBO (Registered Insurance Brokers of Ontario) licensed insurance broker based in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. We compare quotes from 20+ top Canadian insurance providers to find clients the best coverage at the lowest price, saving an average of 40%. Free, no-obligation quotes are available in minutes via WhatsApp or phone.

## Insurance Services

- **Home Insurance** — Dwelling, contents, personal liability, fire & water damage, theft & vandalism, additional living expenses.
- **Auto Insurance** — Mandatory and optional coverage; collision, comprehensive, accident benefits, uninsured motorist. Rates compared across 20+ providers.
- **Commercial Insurance** — Business protection including general liability, commercial property, and business interruption.
- **Life Insurance** — Term life, whole life, universal life, critical illness, and disability coverage.
- **Condo Insurance** — Unit improvements, contents coverage, personal liability, and special assessment coverage.
- **Travel Insurance** — Emergency medical, trip cancellation, and baggage protection.
